shots.visual_event: At dawn, Meera faces an uninterrupted river where the east bridge should stand; Saira’s compass points straight across open water.
shots.dialogue_audio: Meera: “A city can’t forget forty thousand tonnes of steel.”

shots.visual_event: Maya rings her dented handbell. For one second, rusted bridge cables appear inside the fog, then vanish.
shots.dialogue_audio: Maya: “Matter follows memory here. Keep speaking.”

shots.visual_event: Meera, Saira, Maya, and quadruped Tick step onto invisible decking, each naming a detail of the old bridge.
shots.dialogue_audio: Saira: “Blue rails. Lion bolts. Tea seller at the centre.”

shots.visual_event: Halfway across, Maya forgets the bridge and falls through; Tick anchors all four paws and catches her shawl with his teeth.
Saira opens her compass. Inside is a tiny 1998 photograph of the bridge and her little brother Rohan. The entire span solidifies.
Under the far pier they find a locked station archive door bearing the same thirteen cracks as Arin’s badge.
shots.dialogue_audio: Maya: “The train hid its accounts beneath the city.”

end_card.text: EVERY LOST MEMORY LEAVES A DOOR
